name: Beechcraft Premier I (390)
summary: Raytheon's all-composite light jet with a carbon-fiber fuselage, built in modest numbers and still seen on charter and corporate ramps.

engines: Two Williams FJ44 turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Smooth, rounded fuselage with a short row of round windows
tail: T-tail with a swept fin and swept stabilizer

tellTales: Row of round (portlike) windows on a smooth, small fuselage
T-tail with plain wingtips and no winglets
Small, rounded nose and compact rear pods

confusedWith.howToTell: The Phenom 300 has upturned winglets and larger oval windows; the Premier has plain tips and smaller round windows.
The CitationJet has a straight wing and a stubbier fuselage with squarer windows; the Premier has a swept wing, a smoother fuselage and round windows.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
